flags: Current turns Stevens’s written claim of seeing no prior-use traces into an unqualified observation. It is omitted; the same cache acknowledges earlier Indigenous knowledge, and no community account is cached.
Current implies the Wallace Falls hiking route necessarily passes trestle ruins. The cache establishes ruins in the park, not that trail sequence; copy distinguishes them.

The tourism office gives Monroe–Peshastin and 90 miles; the highway article instead describes the byway as ending at Cashmere, and material maps 99.2 miles. Follow the tourism office for public scope and length.
Index’s 155 residents is supported as a 2020 census figure, not an undated current count. It and the namesake detail were cut for focus, not lack of evidence.
The pass practical note records checking the saved tourism page, not live road status.
The cache uses Skykomish affiliation descriptions inconsistently across town histories. No tribe affiliation or treaty interpretation is inferred in this story.
